answer.value: Egypt has shown the most dramatic reduction in female lifespan inequality, with the Gini coefficient decreasing from 0.4608 in early years to 0.1209 in recent years, a reduction of 0.3398. This represents the largest improvement among all countries analyzed. Italy follows with a reduction of 0.2811 (from 0.3558 to 0.0747), and China with a reduction of 0.2555 (from 0.3578 to 0.1023).

key_insights: Egypt shows most dramatic reduction in lifespan inequality with -0.3398 change
All countries show decreasing trends indicating improving lifespan equality
Austria and Japan maintain lowest inequality levels throughout the period

reasoning.reasoning: Filter out other countries to focus on Egypt trend and observe the dramatic decrease in lifespan inequality over time
